title: ColorPalettePopover
description: Fiori color palette popover with external opener, selection dismissal and persistent local palette history.

usage.summary: Choose a predefined color in an on-demand anchored surface.
useWhen: Let users open a contextual chooser to select a predefined color.
Keep the swatches near the opener while preserving space in the page.
Enable showMoreColors when users may choose a color outside the supplied palette.

avoidWhen.when: Keep predefined color swatches visible without opening a surface.
Work directly with arbitrary colors or channel values rather than start from swatches.
